olivia: Heads up — canary cutover at 01:00 UTC. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8124 needs 2x LGTM before cutoff or the canary stays paused. It's a small runtime memfix; smoke passed locally but CI flaky. Can someone give a quick pass in the next 45m? :eyes:
kevin: I can look in ~30m, heads-down on a deploy right now. if someone else can do the quick unit test pass that helps.
sanjay: I'll do a lightweight review now. focus on the mem alloc change and the new guard clause.
release-bot: Canary deployment paused — awaiting approvals (2 required). Triggered by PR 8124.
maria: skimmed the diff — code looks fine, added a tiny nit about a comment. tests still running for me. provisional +1 pending CI green. :thumbsup:
leo: CI timed out on one job (integration-flaky). file a follow-up to re-run that job? If we need to bypass, we should document why.
kevin: done quick local run of the failing integration with mock env — passes. I can give LGTM once CI re-run finishes, or we can merge with a rollback flag if we're short on time.
maria: re-run finished, all green for me. tagging LGTM.
release-bot: CI rerun (job id 8241) passed.
kevin: LGTM. merging after olivia's final go. :white_check_mark:
olivia: OK merging now. will watch canary metrics for 20m, have rollback ready if error rate spikes. thanks all for quick turnaround. :rocket:
tim: pinging on-call to be ready for rollback window.
olive: (typo) — thanks again!
